# Verstera Roofing

> Verstera Roofing is a residential and commercial roofing contractor serving the Austin, San Antonio, and Temple, Texas metropolitan areas, specializing in roof inspection, repair, replacement, and storm restoration, with a core niche in stone-coated steel metal shingle roofing.

## Most Authoritative Resources

- [Verstera Roofing Homepage](https://versteraroofing.com/): Overview of services, licensing, storm damage support, and how to request a quote.
- [About Us](https://versteraroofing.com/index.html#about): Company background and team information.
- [Stone-Coated Steel Roofing Specialty Page](https://versteraroofing.com/stone-coated-steel-metal-shingle-roofing.html): Technical details on stone-coated steel and metal shingle installation, benefits, and architectural applications.
- [Damage Repair](https://versteraroofing.com/damage-repair.html): Storm and structural damage assessment and repair services.
- [Roof Maintenance](https://versteraroofing.com/roof-maintenance.html): Preventative maintenance programs and inspection services.
- [Roofing Certifications](https://versteraroofing.com/roofing-certifications.html): Manufacturer and industry certifications held by Verstera Roofing.
- [Financing](https://versteraroofing.com/financing.html): Available financing options for roofing projects.
- [Gallery](https://versteraroofing.com/gallery.html): Photos of completed roofing projects.
- [Reviews and Client Testimonials](https://versteraroofing.com/reviews-and-testimonials.html): Client reviews, case studies, and satisfaction metrics.
